fields.subject: Allocation of Series 7 motors for November
paragraphs: Our motor supplier lost a plant to fire on November 3. We expect to ship 60 percent of confirmed November quantities of items that use the Series 7 motor.
We are allocating on each customer's share of orders over the last twelve months. We have not reduced the share held for hospital and school accounts.
fields.actionRequested: Confirm acceptance by November 7, 5:00 p.m. Central, or tell us which orders to cancel.
fields.signature: Dana Whitcombe, Director of Supply Planning
